technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish structure (supertrend, hull, EMA 9/21) offset by overbought conditions, weak trend strength (ADX 14.55), and price below intermediate moving averages; moderate confluence but lacks conviction for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (greed score 57, neutral AAII) with no recent news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias on MMM.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 157 crisis regime) combined with critical earnings binary event in 7 days create extreme risk environment for MMM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish with OBV confirmation and price near support (80.0558) offers defined risk entry if macro stabilizes post-earnings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 7 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime (157), price below 50-SMA/EMA-50, weak ADX (14.55), and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Supertrend bullish with price at support offers technical setup, but earnings binary in 7 days combined with VIX crisis regime (157) and inverted yield curve create unacceptable risk asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 7 days presents binary volatility event that will likely gap through technical levels regardless of directional bias; macro environment (inverted curve, VIX 157) amplifies downside tail risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
